matches.title: Amsterdam Trader Summer Internship 2027
matches.content: Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that uses sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade global financial markets. We specialise in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can have a real impact. At Maven, we believe exceptional careers are built deliberately. Our summer internship is designed for a small number of high-potential students each year, combining structured training with practical exposure. We don’t hire large classes expecting only a few to succeed; we invest in every individual who joins the programme. If you would like to be considered for our London Trader Summer Internship, applications will open on 7th September. We can only accept one application per candidate per recruitment cycle, so please ensure you apply to the role you are most interested in.  Programme details Location: Amsterdam Programme dates: 21st June – 20th August 2027 Application deadline: Tuesday 20th October 2026 Key requirements:  You must have the right to work in the region you are applying for at the time of application You must be a penultimate-year undergraduate or master’s student You must not have applied for any other Maven programmes in this cycle Join a structured nine-week internship, giving you a practical introduction to options market making. The programme starts in our London office, with three weeks of interactive options theory classes led by one of our traders. You’ll then return to Amsterdam, quickly progressing into trading simulation and mock trading, helping you build the foundations you need to become a trader. You’ll also gain exposure to different desks through shadowing and project work. Throughout the internship, you’ll be assessed on your performance and development. Successful interns may be considered for our Graduate Trader Programme the following year. What you will be doing Build practical trading skills in our simulation environment, applying your learning to real market scenarios Use the same tools as our traders - or build your own - and observe the same trades being executed in the live market Learn directly from traders across different desks through shadowing and regular interaction, with opportunities to ask questions and understand their day-to-day approach Take part in a dedicated Reading Week, working independently on a project and exploring an area of interest How and what you will learn Build your foundations in options market making - we don’t expect prior knowledge Develop your understanding of options theory, pricing, probability and risk with Maven’s in-house trainers Apply your knowledge through trading simulation, testing different strategies, learning from experience and building confidence as a trader Develop your understanding of the wider market through macroeconomics and technical training Progress through clear learning milestones, with ongoing feedback from the Trading and Emerging Talent teams Who you are Key criteria Strong numeracy skills and a good understanding of probability and statistics A genuine interest in financial markets and a curiosity to learn A willingness to adopt and utilise emerging AI technologies We’re looking for someone who is An entrepreneurial thinker who takes the initiative to generate ideas that further your learning and improve existing tools or systems A critical problem solver and decision-maker who analyses situations and makes effective decisions An agile learner who quickly acquires knowledge, responds to feedback and adapts to new situations Able to synthesise information and turn complex or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable insights and decisions Collaborative and influential , able to build trust, share what you have learned and work effectively with others Results-focused and accountable , comfortable taking ownership and making decisions in the face of uncertainty and with incomplete information Why Maven? Dedicated in-house trainers: Learn through a programme designed for the Summer Trader Internship and delivered by Maven’s traders and in-house experts, covering technical and professional skills, as well as how AI is integrated into our daily work Accelerate your career: Learn by trying new things, making mistakes and developing quickly. We’ve had traders progress to head-of-desk roles within two and a half years of joining as graduates. If you perform well and are ready, you can progress quickly Proven pathways: Around a quarter of our workforce joined through an Emerging Talent Programme, including more than 50 of our current traders Supported to succeed: Receive regular feedback, structured reviews and day-to-day support, including a Maven buddy We invest in you: From the start of the internship, you’ll be immersed in a simulated trading environment and learn directly from traders. Throughout, you’ll gain practical insight into how our desks operate and have the opportunity to demonstrate your potential for the Graduate Trader Programme   Maven is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all candidates regardless of background or identity.   Benefits at Maven As an Intern, you’ll be eligible for benefits including: Regular social events where you can get to know us, from welcome dinners and team bowling to boat tours and end-of-programme celebrations Free breakfast and lunch served daily in the office, plus drinks and snacks throughout the day Free accommodation in London within walking distance of our office, plus assistance with relocation or living costs to support your return to Amsterdam for the remainder of the programme Access to a state-of-the-art on-site gym Work in a forward-thinking environment where AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations

matches.content: Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that uses sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade global financial markets. We specialise in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can have a real impact. At Maven, we believe exceptional careers are built deliberately. Our summer internship is designed for a small number of high-potential students each year, combining structured training with practical exposure. We don’t hire large classes expecting only a few to succeed; we invest in every individual who joins the programme. Programme details Location: London Programme dates: 21st June – 20th August 2027 Application deadline: 21st October 2026 Key requirements: You must have the right to work in the region you are applying for at the time of application You must be a penultimate-year undergraduate or master’s student You must not have applied for any other Maven programmes in this cycle   Join a structured nine-week internship in our London office, giving you a practical introduction to options market making. The programme starts with options theory before quickly progressing to trading simulation and mock trading, helping you build the foundations you need to become a trader. You’ll also gain exposure to different desks through shadowing and project work. Throughout the internship, you’ll be assessed on your performance and development. Successful interns may be considered for our Graduate Trader Programme the following year. What you will be doing Build practical trading skills in our simulation environment, applying your learning to real market scenarios Use the same tools as our traders - or build your own - and observe the same trades being executed in the live market Learn directly from traders across different desks through shadowing and regular interaction, with opportunities to ask questions and understand their day-to-day approach Take part in a dedicated Reading Week, working independently on a project and exploring an area of interest How and what you will learn Build your foundations in options market making - we don’t expect prior knowledge Develop your understanding of options theory, pricing, probability and risk with Maven’s in-house trainers Apply your knowledge through trading simulation, testing different strategies, learning from experience and building confidence as a trader Develop your understanding of the wider market through macroeconomics and technical training Progress through clear learning milestones, with ongoing feedback from the Trading and Emerging Talent teams Who you are Key criteria Strong numeracy skills and a good understanding of probability and statistics A genuine interest in financial markets and a curiosity to learn A willingness to adopt and utilise emerging AI technologies We’re looking for someone who is An entrepreneurial thinker who takes the initiative to generate ideas that further your learning and improve existing tools or systems A critical problem solver and decision-maker who analyses situations and makes effective decisions An agile learner who quickly acquires knowledge, responds to feedback and adapts to new situations Able to synthesise information and turn complex or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable insights and decisions Collaborative and influential , able to build trust, share what you have learned and work effectively with others Results-focused and accountable , comfortable taking ownership and making decisions in the face of uncertainty and with incomplete information Why Maven? Dedicated in-house trainers: Learn through a programme designed for the Summer Trader Internship and delivered by Maven’s traders and in-house experts, covering technical and professional skills, as well as how AI is integrated into our daily work Accelerate your career: Learn by trying new things, making mistakes and developing quickly. We’ve had traders progress to head-of-desk roles within two and a half years of joining as graduates. If you perform well and are ready, you can progress quickly Proven pathways: Around a quarter of our workforce joined through an Emerging Talent Programme, including more than 50 of our current traders Supported to succeed: Receive regular feedback, structured reviews and day-to-day support, including a Maven buddy We invest in you: From the start of the internship, you’ll be immersed in a simulated trading environment and learn directly from traders. Throughout, you’ll gain practical insight into how our desks operate and have the opportunity to demonstrate your potential for the Graduate Trader Programme Maven is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all candidates regardless of background or identity. Benefits at Maven As an intern, you’ll be eligible for benefits including: Regular social events where you can get to know us, from welcome dinners and the Maven summer party to end-of-programme celebrations Free daily breakfast and lunch in the office, as well as snacks and drinks On-site gym access, with regular classes and in-office massages A forward-thinking environment in which AI is integral to our strategy and daily operations

matches.title: Quant Trader Internship 2027 (6 months)
matches.content: Maven Securities is a leading proprietary trading firm that leverages sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to trade in global financial markets. We specialise in options and derivatives market making, where your skills can be directly applied to have a real impact. Please note, this Quant Trader Internship is 6 months, full-time. If you would like to be considered for our Chicago Trader Summer Internship, please apply here . Alternatively, if you would like to be considered for our London Trader Summer Internship, applications will open on 7th September. We can only accept one application per candidate per recruitment cycle, so please ensure you apply to the role you are most interested in.  THE ROLE As a Quantitative Trader Intern, you’ll engage in an intensive 6-month training programme focused on options market making. You’ll collaborate closely with traders and researchers to solve meaningful research challenges and develop your expertise in quantitative methods across our market-making desks. Upon successfully completing the internship, you will be eligible for consideration for a full time position. As a Quant Trader Intern, your responsibilities will include: Solving quantitative research problems such as volatility modelling, alpha generation and validation Creating visualisation tools using Python or AI-assisted code Completing a structured research project under the mentorship of traders and quants Shadowing our Options Market Making desks   WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR Background in Applied Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Physics, or a similar quantitative discipline Proficient in programming with at least one language (preferably Python however C++ or C# is advantageous too) Quick and creative problem-solver, able to tackle new or unfamiliar challenges independently Strong communicator with the ability to present research findings clearly and effectively Self-starter with a keen interest in refining current trading strategies and uncovering new opportunities Familiarity with financial markets is a plus, though not essential Professional-level fluency in English   WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU: A fast-growing global firm with plenty of opportunities to have a significant impact Flat hierarchal environment and informal dress code Competitive compensation package On-site private gym with instructor-led classes including boxing, yoga, and more Monthly company events and social activities Flexible start date: January 2027 or July 2027   PLEASE NOTE We only accept one application per candidate per recruitment cycle Visa sponsorship is available for this role and will be discussed with eligible candidates at later stages of the process For more information on our assessment process and commonly asked questions, please visit the Emerging Talent page on Maven’s website

matches.title: Software Engineer – 2027 Internship Program (June Start)
matches.content: Old Mission is a global proprietary trading firm that leverages state-of-the-art technology and research to identify and execute profitable trading strategies across multiple asset classes around the world. Our offices in Chicago, New York, and London are all composed of naturally-curious individuals who thrive in a team environment and constantly strive for improvement. About the Position Our internship program is geared for current students who want to work alongside our talented software engineers creating impactful solutions to further the firm's market initiatives. We are a smaller firm, which means you'll get to know the people you're working with and they'll get to know you. Responsibilities include supporting the development of C++ based trading applications and tools. You will be given hands-on projects that contribute to the firm's daily activities, giving you real exposure to how our business runs, not just observation. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to learn more about creative programming and the tools needed to support electronic trading. If you're looking to make an immediate contribution this summer and get a firsthand look at building out our business, feel free to apply today! What you will get to do Gain exposure to how trading works, from the underlying theory to the systems and tools we build around it Regular sessions with senior engineers covering the fundamentals of the systems and tools we use Get direct feedback from the engineers you're working alongside, learning in real time Work directly with engineers, traders, and other teams on projects that matter to the firm day to day Required Skills Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field Minimum 3.0 GPA  A strong work ethic and ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment At least junior standing, with a graduation date of December 2027 or May 2028 Comfortable with one or more of C++, Python or TypeScript A solid grasp of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, systems Genuine interest in markets and how software supports them Ability to start the internship on June 1, 2027 No finance experience is required Benefits and Perks Fully stocked kitchen; free breakfast and lunch every day on-site Corporate housing at no cost to you Access to people across the firm — traders, researchers, and engineers Base Salary Range   $150,000 - $200,000 - Salaries are based on numerous factors such as skills, experience, and education. For more information, reach out to your recruiter.  Old Mission is not accepting unsolicited resumes from any staffing/search firms. All resumes submitted by staffing/search firms to any employee at Old Mission via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid signed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Old Mission, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Old Mission.

matches.title: 2027 Shanghai FPGA Developer Summer Internship
matches.content: At Optiver, FPGAs play a critical role in executing successful trades. With no external clients, we operate in a fast feedback, quick release environment.  As a FPGA Developer Intern at Optiver, you’ll work alongside experienced hardware engineers to ensure we have the fastest and most reliable trading systems in the industry. You’ll constantly be innovating with new technology in the hardware space, ensuring our latency is optimised to nanoseconds. By the end of the 8-week internship, you’ll have deepened your understanding of how technology is used in the quantitative trading industry. Plus, if you’ve excelled over the summer, you’ll receive an offer to return as a Graduate FPGA Developer. What you’ll do: Led by our in-house education team that consists of ex-traders and engineers, you’ll delve into advanced engineering concepts and lead innovative projects, during our world-class training program. In just a few weeks, you’ll develop latency-critical applications that contribute towards our trading success. During the internship, you will be paired with one of Optiver’s seasoned FPGA developers, providing you exposure to a variety of areas, including: Designing highly accurate and efficient systems that respond to the financial markets in real time. Improving infrastructure and trading systems using the latest FPGA devices, tools and techniques. Developing rigorous RTL codes or test benches using a combination of VHDL and System Verilog. Investigate and explore innovative machine learning algorithms and cutting-edge data communication/processing technologies to optimize and enhance existing trading systems. Aside from technical skills, our dedicated education team will also work with you on your development, including:   Workshops on a variety of tech-based topics, along with soft skills to support your holistic growth as a developer. A dedicated mentor who will guide you through our development process and how our trading systems work. Trader training to get you up to speed on our business. This helps you understand the fundamentals of trading, enabling you to make an impact from the early stages of your Optiver career. What you’ll get: You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the most complex problems in the financial markets. In addition, you’ll receive: A highly competitive remuneration package. Optiver-covered flights and accommodation for the duration of the internship. The opportunity to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment. Training, mentorship and personal development opportunities. Gym membership, plus weekly in-house chair massages. Daily breakfast, lunch and in-house barista. Regular social events.  Who you are: Masters or PhD Students who are graduating in 2028 or after 2027 September . Studying an Electronic/ Electrical Engineering/ Microelectronics/ Computer Science or similarly technical degree. Familiar with Xilinx or Intel FPGA device architecture, design flows, tools, and digital logic design concepts. Familiar with HDL languages: VHDL and/or Verilog as well as some experience with Python and/or C++. Knowledgeable about Linux commands and scripts. Understand network protocols: Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP. Deeply passionate about technology, particularly FPGA hardware, and have a range of out-of-classroom projects or activities to prove it. Team players who love working with like-minded peers and are always looking to learn and improve. Interested in the trading/quantitative finance industry (previous knowledge is not required).  How to apply: Don’t miss your chance to accelerate your career and thrive on one of the most dynamic trading floors in mainland China. matches.title: 2027 Shanghai Performance Researcher Summer Internship

Under the guidance and mentorship of industry experts, you’ll apply your critical mindset and strong technical skills to drive measurable improvements to trading execution. Analyze market, order, system, and network data to reconstruct event flows and uncover performance patterns. Build analyses, prototypes, metrics, and visualizations to test ideas and quantify results. Work with traders, researchers, and engineers to evaluate and implement improvements. matches.content: Optiver FPGA Engineers build hardware systems where nanoseconds matter. Their work spans highly parallel algorithms, low-level networking and latency-critical applications that operate in live markets. They work closely with traders, software engineers and researchers to understand how trading strategies behave in production, then turn that context into systems that are fast, reliable and efficient. Optiver is building with cutting edge AI technology in the most competitive, data rich landscapes in the world: financial markets. You’ll work side-by-side with your mentor to build latency-critical applications, parallel systems and networking interfaces, giving you a clear view of how low-level engineering decisions connect to trading outcomes. You’ll tackle real issues that will test your critical thinking and problem-solving acumen, and each day will bring new challenges that require fresh perspectives. You’ll design and implement data stores and APIs, monitor data processes and build production-ready datasets that researchers and traders can use effectively.   Data Platform Engineer – Build and maintain the infrastructure used to ingest, process and serve data across our research environment. We review applications on a rolling basis.   Technical Assessment – Selected candidates will complete a coding challenge focused on core programming and problem-solving skills.   Interviews – Shortlisted candidates will take part in interviews, either on-site or via Microsoft Teams. This gives our researchers access to large and diverse datasets, sophisticated research tools  and the infrastructure needed to turn research ideas into live trading strategies.   Our internships are designed to give students meaningful experience of that process. You’ll join a systematic team, work on real research or trading problems and learn from experienced researchers and traders. The environment is rigorous and collaborative: ideas are tested against data, assumptions are challenged and good questions matter as much as quick answers.   Your future role at QRT   Throughout the recruitment process, we’ll consider your skills and interests alongside the problems our teams are working on, with the aim of finding the strongest fit.   As a Quantitative Research Intern, you could contribute in one of two complementary areas within one of QRT’s systematic teams, spanning high, mid and low frequencies:   Research   Your focus will be on developing predictive signals from large and varied datasets. You’ll explore the data for patterns and form hypotheses about what might be driving them. From there, research is iterative: you’ll design tests, question the results, adjust your approach and test again. Working with other researchers, you’ll learn to distinguish promising signals from noise. In doing so, you’ll experience the full research process, from an initial observation to something that can be used in live trading.   Trading   You’ll contribute to the live deployment of QRT’s research by working directly with our systematic trading platform. You’ll monitor how signals behave in production, track performance, improve execution efficiency and help identify and manage potential risks. Working closely with senior Researchers and Traders you’ll investigate how strategies behave in production and look for ways to make them more robust and scalable. You’ll use quantitative analysis and programming to understand what is happening in live systems and determine where improvements can be made.   Across both areas,  how you approach a problem matter. We’re looking for interns who are curious, creative and collaborative. You should be comfortable exploring ideas, asking questions and learning  as you go.   Your present skillset   Academic background  – Pursuing an advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or Engineering.   Quantitative foundations  – Strong analytical skills and an interest in using mathematics, statistics and computation to understand complex problems.   Programming  – Coding experience in at least one leading programming language, including Python, C++ or C#.   Research interests  – Knowledge of statistics, machine learning, NLP or AI techniques is useful but not essential.   Data  – Experience exploring large datasets across multiple time horizons is a plus.   Problem solving  – Able to work through complex problems rigorously while maintaining strong attention to detail.   Independence and collaboration  – Comfortable working autonomously while exchanging ideas and working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds.   Communication  – Able to explain your reasoning and communicate technical ideas clearly.   Languages  – Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.   Interviewing   Apply Online  – Submit your application online. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis by our Talent Acquisition team. We read applications carefully, so thoughtful answers that explain your interests and motivations are useful.   Technical Assessment   –  Selected candidates will complete a coding challenge focused on core programming and problem-solving  skills .   Interviews  – Shortlisted candidates will take part in interviews, either on-site or via Microsoft Teams. We’ll explore your quantitative and technical thinking, how you approach unfamiliar problems and how you work with others.   We also encourage candidates to take part in one of our  Data Challenges . These are an opportunity to work on problems relevant to quantitative research and demonstrate your analytical and technical approach. Strong performance may lead to direct follow-up from our team:  Challenge data (ens.fr)   QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

The environment is technical, collaborative and demanding, with plenty of scope to ask questions, test ideas and take ownership. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantitative developers, researchers and traders, contributing to production technology and solving problems where performance, reliability and good engineering judgement matter.   Depending on your interests and strengths, you may join one of two Technology disciplines.   Software Engineer (London , Wrocław, Zurich )   Software Engineers build the technology that underpins QRT’s trading and investment activities. This includes the platforms and infrastructure that connect us to global markets, brokers and data providers, as well as the systems used for order generation, execution, analytics, risk management and P&L reporting.   The engineering problems vary considerably in scale and shape. At one end, we build ultra-low-latency execution technology where small improvements can matter. At the other, we develop global, cross-asset platforms that need to process large volumes of data reliably and make complex information accessible to users across the firm.   As an intern, you’ll work with experienced engineers, quantitative developers and researchers on a defined technical problem. It’s a collaborative role with direct exposure to quantitative research, financial markets and production trading systems.   Examples of projects you may work on include:   Real-Time Trading Systems – Build high-performance C++ systems for real-time trading, contributing to low-latency infrastructure and execution technology where every microsecond can matter.   Quantitative Research Platforms – Help develop the platforms used for quantitative research across QRT, including machine learning systems and data pipelines that allow researchers to test and scale ideas efficiently.   Research and Trading Tools – Design tools that simplify workflows, improve access to data and make complex information easier to understand through effective visualisation. matches.title: 2027 – Internship, Quantitative Research and Trading
matches.content: Programme duration:  4–6 months, starting in 2027   Who qualifies:  Penultimate or final-year students completing a bachelor’s, master’s or PhD degree   Qube Research & Technologies (QRT)  is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager operating across liquid asset classes and markets worldwide. Our approach to investing is scientific: we bring together data, research, technology and trading expertise to develop and run systematic strategies.   Research is central to how QRT invests. Over the years, we have built a global research and execution platform spanning geographies, asset classes and trading horizons, from high to low frequency. This gives our researchers access to large and diverse datasets, sophisticated research tools  and the infrastructure needed to turn research ideas into live trading strategies.   Our internships are designed to give students meaningful experience of that process. You’ll join a systematic team, work on real research or trading problems and learn from experienced researchers and traders. The environment is rigorous and collaborative: ideas are tested against data, assumptions are challenged and good questions matter as much as quick answers.   Your future role at QRT   Throughout the recruitment process, we’ll consider your skills and interests alongside the problems our teams are working on, with the aim of finding the strongest fit.   As a Quantitative Research Intern, you could contribute in one of two complementary areas within one of QRT’s systematic teams, spanning high, mid and low frequencies:   Research   Your focus will be on developing predictive signals from large and varied datasets. You’ll explore the data for patterns and form hypotheses about what might be driving them. From there, research is iterative: you’ll design tests, question the results, adjust your approach and test again. Working with other researchers, you’ll learn to distinguish promising signals from noise. In doing so, you’ll experience the full research process, from an initial observation to something that can be used in live trading.   Trading   You’ll contribute to the live deployment of QRT’s research by working directly with our systematic trading platform. You’ll monitor how signals behave in production, track performance, improve execution efficiency and help identify and manage potential risks. Working closely with senior Researchers and Traders you’ll investigate how strategies behave in production and look for ways to make them more robust and scalable. You’ll use quantitative analysis and programming to understand what is happening in live systems and determine where improvements can be made.   Across both areas,  how you approach a problem matter. We’re looking for interns who are curious, creative and collaborative. You should be comfortable exploring ideas, asking questions and learning  as you go.   Your present skillset   Academic background  – Pursuing an advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or Engineering.   Quantitative foundations  – Strong analytical skills and an interest in using mathematics, statistics and computation to understand complex problems.   Programming  – Coding experience in at least one leading programming language, including Python, C++ or C#.   Research interests  – Knowledge of statistics, machine learning, NLP or AI techniques is useful but not essential.   Data  – Experience exploring large datasets across multiple time horizons is a plus.   Problem solving  – Able to work through complex problems rigorously while maintaining strong attention to detail.   Independence and collaboration  – Comfortable working autonomously while exchanging ideas and working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds.   Communication  – Able to explain your reasoning and communicate technical ideas clearly.   Languages  – Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.   Interviewing   Apply Online  – Submit your application online. Nos ingénieurs règlent des problèmes complexes dans les domaines de la programmation à faible latence, de la technologie FPGA, de l’accélération matérielle et de l’apprentissage automatique. Notre investissement continu dans les meilleurs talents d’ingénierie et dans les meilleures technologies garantit que notre plateforme demeure inégalée en termes de fonctionnalité, d’évolutivité et de performance. Ce poste exige une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, puisque le poste implique des interactions régulières avec des membres anglophones internationaux de l’équipe. C’est pourquoi nous favorisons une culture où les personnes intelligentes et motivées prospèrent, sans les egos. matches.title: 2027 Internship - FPGA Engineer
matches.content: Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting edge technology to deliver liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide. Virtu's internship programme offers students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have built a thoughtful and challenging curriculum with projects that introduce students to the many complex and ever-changing problems to solve. Students can expect a company-curated global training week for our interns, real trading and quantitative problems to solve throughout the programme, and engaging social events to get to know our team and culture.  Location:  Dublin, Ireland (onsite) Dates : 10 week programme, starting 21 June 2027 - 27 August 2027 Training : Ongoing training throughout the summer Projects : Real problems to solve throughout the programme. Interns will work from a list of projects and have several senior mentors throughout the programme. Perks : Daily catered lunches, fully stocked kitchen, on-site gym & workout classes, games room, social events and laundry service. THE ROLE At Virtu, our internship is designed to put you at the very center of ultra-low latency trading. You will tackle the actual engineering challenges that keep our trading systems competitive, paired with experienced engineers who mentor you through projects where every nanosecond counts. Our hardware team designs both FPGA and ASIC solutions that sit at the heart of our market-making infrastructure. You'll work across the full design lifecycle — from architecture and RTL implementation through simulation, verification, and bring-up on live hardware. At the end of your internship, you'll have turned an idea into something real, tangible, and running on silicon. No finance background is required. We are looking for curious engineers who thrive on hard problems at the boundary of hardware and software. What matters most is how you think and how you learn. Requirements Academic background in Electrical or Computer Engineering Experienced with Hardware Description Languages (SystemVerilog, Verilog) Experience working with FPGA vendor tools — Vivado or Quartus for FPGAs Comfortable with Software programming languages (Python, C++, or similar) Interested in learning how FPGAs and ASICs are used in the context of low latency trading systems Strong problem solving and communication skills Graduating year of 2028 THE PROCESS    After applicants pass an initial resume screening, an online programming test will be emailed to you via HackerRank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you! Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

matches.content: About Wincent We are a team of over 150 people, primarily Engineers, Traders and Quants, focused on HFT with ~1% of global crypto trading volume. Being a bit weird, we Are self-taught; our founders do not come from any of the big HFTs Chose to have no VCs on cap-table; this spot is for our colleagues Made Bratislava the central hub, not London or Amsterdam Culture When you do something you love, it does not feel like work. Being in the money making business is good, but that alone is not worth our soul; we follow the motto “Be the good guys in the market”. Say things as they are Life is too short for games of politics, fluff, or bullshit in general. Trust each other We embrace internal radical transparency in terms of compensation, bonuses, and trading strategie Quant Research/Trading Internship - Summer 2027 with Relocation Provided Would you like to be paired with experienced traders who will teach you how to identify market signals, analyze and execute trading strategies, conduct statistical analysis, construct quantitative models, and enhance your trading intuition? If you answered "YES," we've got something special for you: Join us as a Quantitative Research/Trading Intern on-site in Bratislava, Slovakia. We support European and UK citizens with accommodation & travel arrangements. You'll dive into the exciting world of cryptocurrency trading, gain hands-on experience in quantitative analysis, algorithm development, and market research. As a Quant Intern, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, learn from experienced quant traders, and gain practical experience to get a head start on your trading career. Working on projects alongside mentors will give you a sense of the variety of problems we solve every day.
